source.working_tree: dirty; the frozen snapshot is a selected source candidate and unrelated checkout changes remain preserved

frozen_snapshot.filesystem_custody: Replacement artifact root and source directories are mode 0500; regular source files are mode 0400 except executable files mode 0500; local-sources.json is mode 0400. Owner bolyki may read/execute but cannot modify the retained snapshot without an explicit permission change.
frozen_snapshot.snapshot_policy: The manifest covers the selected source candidate bytes and executable bits. It excludes .git, target, Python caches, .DS_Store, AGENTS.md, docs/development, docs/plans, docs/superpowers, and .superpowers. No package, image, runtime state, credential, certificate, key, bearer or vehicle-data bytes are included.

includes: Pinned Fleet Telemetry lock, patch, and bridge build/test scripts
Debian and macOS package recipes, service units, hooks, plists, and support files
Dockerfile, Compose file, Docker examples, and operational documentation
Owned Rust contract tests and the source-controlled interop/matrix contract
excludes: Git metadata, build output, caches and generated reports
Private development status, historical runtime handoffs and guest evidence
TLS certificates and private keys, bearer values, credential stores and fixture/session inputs
Tesla account credentials, vehicle commands and passive vehicle data

native_arm64_binaries.limit: Private candidate build identity only; not an aggregate installed receipt.

receiver_bridge_builds.limit: Build evidence; no target-installed receiver acceptance is implied.

debian_arm64_package.limit: The retained receipt has no package filename/path and records this as an uninstalled package candidate. The later ARM64 installed lifecycle receipt must not be inferred from this hash.

macos_arm64_package.limit: The package candidate was not installed; LaunchAgent lifecycle is represented only by its separate target receipt.

macos_arm64_lifecycle_identity.limit: This is an installed ARM64 lifecycle subset, not full X1, x86_64, upgrade/rollback, passive provenance or aggregate profile acceptance.

docker_arm64_image.limit: The isolated image/runtime shape, mount separation, health, restart and receiver-wire subset passed; Docker-to-Hub durable ACK and cross-platform lifecycle are not claimed.

docker_amd64_image.limit: The target-aware source recipe and linux-amd64 bridge build exist, but no amd64 image identity or runtime receipt is available.

runtime.roles: Edge core and Fleet receiver are independently selectable systemd units

selectors.limit: The receipt covers ARM64 package lifecycle and receiver-wire subset only; it does not cover native amd64, full R1, passive provenance or X1.

runtime.roles: One image with separately selectable Edge and receiver services

selectors.limit: No Docker-to-Hub durable commit/ACK receipt is bound to this selector.

runtime.roles: Core and Fleet receiver LaunchAgents start, stop and restart independently

selectors.limit: Upgrade/rollback, Docker-on-macOS, native amd64, passive provenance and full X1 remain unproven.

runtime.required: Fresh authorized Debian 13 x86_64 target and package/runtime receipt

selectors.blocked_reason: No fresh target receipt is available; retained or quarantined guests cannot be promoted.

runtime.required: Fresh authorized Docker daemon and target-specific image/runtime receipt

selectors.limit: The architecture mapping is source/build evidence only; no amd64 image, mount, service or lifecycle acceptance is claimed.

owns: Edge core binary and encrypted spool
Receiver sidecar payload, pinned bridge lock/patch and receiver configuration
Edge package recipes, service units, LaunchAgents, Docker image/Compose source and operational docs
never_owns: Tesla account credentials or vehicle commands
Hub ledger, registry, fixture, Hub credentials or ACK policy
Home Assistant database, registry, configuration or native service

owns: Vehicle Fleet Telemetry mTLS/WebSocket inputs and receiver process
must_not_read: Edge spool key, Edge state, Hub client identity, Hub bearer

owns: Aggregate component manifest, selectors, installer orchestration, Hub credentials, fixture, ledger and runtime receipts
must_not_promote: A source snapshot, static Compose parse, package build or isolated runtime-shape result into installed acceptance

debian_native.receiver_private_key: owner-only 0600 and readable only by the receiver service identity

lifecycle.selection: The aggregate installer must require an explicit Edge selector and preserve core-only versus core-plus-receiver selection; no receiver is silently enabled by Hub core.
lifecycle.install: Verify the external source manifest and exact candidate identities before building or staging. Source/bootstrap preparation never starts a service. Native and macOS package installation must preserve explicit selection and service state.
lifecycle.start: Start Edge core first; start the receiver only after its selected configuration and vehicle mTLS inputs pass ownership checks. Docker uses the named Compose project and selected services.
lifecycle.stop: Stop the receiver before Edge with the bounded supervisor allowance. Verify listeners are closed while retaining state for a data-preserving uninstall or rollback.
lifecycle.upgrade_rollback: Debian maintainer hooks capture prior payload/service state and restore it on abort or failure. The spool and `/var/lib/teslatlas-edge` are never deleted by upgrade/rollback.
lifecycle.remove: Disable and stop selected services, remove only owned payloads, preserve Edge state by default, and require an explicit destructive data option for deletion. Never use a volume-deleting Docker cleanup for acceptance.
lifecycle.acceptance: Every selected target requires a redacted runtime receipt bound to the source manifest, artifact identity, target identity, state before/after, readiness/function result and ordered cleanup.

receipt_schema.promotion_rule: A source payload, static check, package build, image digest or isolated runtime shape is never an installed selector acceptance result without the target receipt.
receipt_schema.secret_policy: Never record private key, bearer, invitation, certificate bytes, database password, raw response, vehicle identity, transaction payload or credential-store contents. Hashes, versions, architecture, counts, modes, owners, listener scope and redacted status are permitted.
receipt_schema.failure_rule: An interrupted or partially observed selector remains failed or pending; do not synthesize missing phases or retry a consumed runtime action.

evidence.security_boundary: The successful r13 runtime receipt is retained separately and is not reused or promoted as a D1 aggregate receipt.

hub_action_requested: Verify the replacement owner-only read-only snapshot and local-sources manifest, bind this Edge handoff into the Hub-owned aggregate manifest without widening any selector status, and require fresh target receipts for every pending or source-only selector.
